We are thrilled to introduce @ADMupdates as Summit Partner of #WorldBiodiversitySummit2024! 🤝

As a global leader in both human and animal nutrition, ADM is at the forefront of creating sustainable, science-based solutions that address the critical challenges of our global food system. For over 120 years, ADM has been committed to sustainable stewardship and transforming value chains to revitalise nature and support a resilient future.

"At ADM, we’re committed to our critical role in building a more sustainable and resilient global food system. For 120 years, ADM has been deeply connected to the land and sustainable stewardship, and today our business and nature are interlinked in countless ways. That is why we are committed to leading in transforming the multiple value chains in which we operate, building new ways of operating that not only sustain but also revitalize nature. We’re committed to leveraging our unique role to build a better future, and we are proud to partner with World Climate Foundation in this effort."

- Alison Taylor, Chief Sustainability Officer, ADM
